pkgmetadata.longdescription: Official Python client for the Tavily API, a web search engine built for LLM and RAG pipelines. It exposes a synchronous TavilyClient and an asyncio AsyncTavilyClient covering search, extract, crawl and map, plus a TavilyHybridClient that combines Tavily results with a local vector store. Results can be trimmed to a token budget, which is why tiktoken is a hard runtime dependency. The PyPI distribution is named tavily-python; the importable module is tavily.
